instruction: Look up baby name details for Liam on BabyCenter.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully navigated from babycenter.com/child to Baby Names section, searched for 'Carl', found the details page at babycenter.com/baby-names/details/carl-853, and scrolled to the similar names section. Handled privacy dialog and signup popup along the way.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can handle privacy dialogs and popups, navigate babycenter.com navigation menu, use the baby name search feature, scroll through page content to find specific sections
metadata.task_rationale: Same navigation pattern as original but with a different name (Liam). Tests the model's ability to generalize the baby name search workflow to a different target name.
metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating from babycenter.com/child to the baby names section, searching for 'Liam', and reaching the Liam details page. Evaluator checks that the active URL matches the babycenter baby name details page for Liam using regex pattern matching.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter 'active_url_from_accessTree' correctly extracts the active Chrome tab URL from the accessibility tree with appropriate 'https://www.' prefix.
Metric 'is_expected_url_pattern_match' correctly receives rules dict via get_rule and accesses rules['expected'] to get the pattern list.
Regex pattern 'babycenter\.com/baby-names/details/liam' semantically verifies the instruction to look up Liam's baby name details on BabyCenter.
URL verification is sufficient coverage for the single-step instruction of navigating to Liam's details page.
Unanchored re.search correctly handles BabyCenter URLs that include numeric ID suffixes (e.g., /liam-1234).
